phases.objective: Prove the merged environment-authority foundation and the bounded B04-B09 deployment-authority candidate are internally consistent, policy-derived, exact-SHA fail-closed, no-secret, and executable in synthetic tests without applying migrations or mutating GitHub protected branches or Hostinger production.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Spec 018 environment authority plus Hostinger deploy compatibility surface
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A deployment candidate can proceed past branch authority only when the effective branch is the governed Production branch and expected_commit_sha equals its same-cycle GitHub head; unauthorized branch selection and stale SHA fail closed before deploy dispatch.
steps: Load the SQL-first environment branch authority and its repository-policy fallback without reading provider credentials.
Resolve the governed production branch and treat any caller branch only as a compatibility assertion that must match authority.
Read the current Production branch ref through the governed read-only GitHub authority path and compare it with expected_commit_sha.
Reject main, arbitrary branches, invalid SHA, and stale SHA before deploy planning can become eligible.
Verify the Hostinger deploy executor and caller schemas consume only the policy-derived branch while routine SSH mutation remains blocked by target policy.

Verify the precise OpenAPI registry owns the deploy-release operation, its path-item contract exposes no caller-selectable branch, and the legacy replacement transition is constrained to the exact historical operation identity/security/request shape.
Verify Spec 018 completion evidence describes the same no-migration/no-production-mutation boundary.
assertions: No governed caller schema exposes branch as a selectable production deployment input.
The effective deployment branch is resolved from environment_branch_authority_v1 and is Production.
expected_commit_sha must equal the current same-cycle Production branch head before dispatch.
Caller branch main or any arbitrary work branch fails before GitHub readback or deploy dispatch.
The precise OpenAPI route contract removes caller branch selection and is registered for deterministic root OpenAPI synchronization.

Legacy root OpenAPI replacement remains fail-closed unless signature, route file, operationId, admin security, consequential flag, and historical required request fields all match the bounded transition.
The candidate does not apply migrations, write main or Production, invoke Hostinger mutation, or return secrets.

phases.objective: Complete runtime immutability, break-glass lifecycle, canonical-resource resolution, and generated attestation through bounded follow-up pull requests after the environment/deployment authority foundation is merged.
Prove dirty-runtime detection, break-glass expiry, rollback, reconciliation, provider/readback faults, and no-secret evidence under failure conditions.
Validate the integrated candidate on main staging with exact-SHA readback and no production mutation before promotion.
Verify exact Production SHA promotion, immutable Hostinger runtime alignment, generated deployment attestation, rollback readiness, and post-deploy integrity under separate release authorization.
